title: Complexity Induction: Compositional Generalization via Structured Label Distortion
abstract: arXiv:2608.21464v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We demonstrate that structured distortion of training data - which we term complexity induction - can induce compositional generalization in a standard CNN classifier without architectural modification. Using synthetic images of colored geometric shapes, we encode classes as flat string labels (e.g., "red-circle") with no explicit attribute decomposition, and exclude certain color-shape combinations from training entirely. We apply two distortion methods derived from Jaccard string similarity between class names: mixed labels (soft target distributions encoding inter-class overlap) and expanded dataset (false training samples with structurally motivated incorrect labels). Both methods induce the ability to predict unseen class combinations, and act at different levels: mixed labels activate the classifier for unseen combinations by exploiting the CNN's natural embedding structure, while expanded training improves the embedding factoriz

translated_title: 复杂性诱导：通过结构化标签畸变实现组合泛化
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.21464v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：我们证明了训练数据的结构化畸变——我们称之为复杂性诱导——可以在不修改架构的情况下，诱导标准CNN分类器实现组合泛化。使用合成图像中的彩色几何形状，我们将类别编码为扁平字符串标签（例如，“红色-圆形”），不进行显式属性分解，并完全排除某些颜色-形状组合的训练。我们应用了两种基于类别名称之间Jaccard字符串相似性的畸变方法：混合标签（编码类间重叠的软目标分布）和扩展数据集（具有结构化动机错误标签的虚假训练样本）。两种方法都能诱导预测未见类别组合的能力，并在不同层面起作用：混合标签通过利用CNN的自然嵌入结构激活未见组合的分类器，而扩展训练则改善嵌入因子化。
tldr: 本文通过两种结构化标签畸变方法（混合标签和扩展数据集），在不改变CNN架构的情况下，成功诱导了模型对未见颜色-形状组合的预测能力，实现了组合泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper induces compositional generalization in a standard CNN without architectural changes by applying two structured label distortion methods—mixed labels and expanded dataset—enabling prediction of unseen color-shape combinations.
